levels.title: Activate the Vault
levels.mission: Organise the treasures into a Max Heap using valid parent-child swaps.

levels.title: Repair the Security Locks
levels.mission: Choose heapify up or heapify down to restore the disturbed Max Heap.

levels.title: Crack the Treasure Queue
levels.mission: Extract each maximum while preserving the heap after every operation.

levels.title: Beat the Alarm
levels.mission: Clear the vault with repeated extract-max operations before the alarm fills.

levels.title: Final Vault Sort
levels.mission: Run Heap Sort and leave every treasure in ascending order.
